description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai MaKaBo Brings Comfort and Care to Mothers at Shatabdi Hospital

Kandivali, Mumbai | 21st July 2026

The Rotary Club of Mumbai MaKaBo organized a Maternity Gown Distribution Drive at Shatabdi Hospital, Kandivali, bringing comfort and dignity to underprivileged mothers and newborn families.

A total of 150 maternity gowns in various sizes were distributed across the Maternity Ward, Expectant Mothers' Ward, Newborn Ward, Children's Ward, and NICU. The initiative was warmly appreciated by the beneficiaries, hospital staff, and families, who expressed heartfelt gratitude for the thoughtful gesture.

Rtn. Alka, Project Chair, said, "Every mother deserves care, comfort, and dignity. Through this initiative, we aimed to support underprivileged mothers with a small gesture of love and compassion."

The Rotary Club of Mumbai MaKaBo continues to serve the community through meaningful projects that make a positive difference in people's lives.

Service Above Self
